description: The Municipality of Puebla's environment secretariat publishes its municipal green areas inventory, the administrative instrument that identifies municipal plots designated as parks and gardens. Files are offered for 2019, 2020 and 2021, then half-yearly from 2022 to the second half of 2025. Coverage: the municipality of Puebla, Mexico. Access: free CSV files with previews on the municipal open data portal (released January 2021, modified February 2026). Licence: the portal's Libre Uso MX open licence. Caveats: the attribute structure was not inspected and may change between releases; the page lists no geometry format, so mapping may need address matching. Simulation uses: tracking the stock of municipal parks and gardens over time, green-space access and urban heat mitigation planning in a Mexican city. Related records: the Bogotá urban parks inventory and the UN-Habitat open space indicator.
